skills.elemental_burst: Klee's Blazing Delight! For the duration of this ability, continuously summons Sparks 'n' Splash to attack nearby opponents, dealing AoE Pyro DMG. The effects of this skill end when Klee leaves the field. Sparks 'n' Splash can be triggered once every seconds, resulting in instances. The first Sparks 'n' Splash is triggered second after the burst animation, and the last Sparks 'n' Splash is triggered at the very end of the duration. Each Sparks 'n' Splash sends sparks, randomly targeting all enemies.
